season.evidence: NPS lists mid-July through October for the La Crosse Pass trail; another page gives June-September for the peak; logged ascents Jul 8, Aug 4. Kept Jul-Sep (stored).

Not a trailhead-to-summit line, so not applied.

facts.text: The summit tower is steeper than the Class 2 rating suggests: short Class 3-4 steps and a slot on loose, dirty rock (July).
Take the southeast corner of the summit tower: loose shale to a small notch, a short step, then crest scrambling to a brief ledge and a steep slot to the top (July).
Rather than retrace the crest, a lower traverse back toward the pass is possible, but it crosses a deep washout gully on the sub-summit's face and is just as slow (July).

notes: Summit pin 28 m from the surveyed coordinate, fine. Only one route on the peak. Best track 3312734 not applied because it begins 20 km from the stored trailhead (probably a camp-based day). Trailhead pin not touched.
